source_title: Battle for Uttar Pradesh Heats Up: BJP Targets 313 Seats, UCC Rollout & SP Retaliates - India Today - India Today
source_excerpt:
Political activity in Uttar Pradesh has intensified ahead of next year's assembly elections as the Bharatiya Janata Party sets a target of 313 seats and targets a third consecutive term. Addressing party workers in Lucknow, Union Home Minister Amit Shah announced that the Uniform Civil Code would be implemented in the state if the NDA returns to power. He also challenged Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav and Congress leader Rahul Gandhi to a parliamentary debate regarding the Election Commission. Meanwhile, following close results in recent legislative council elections, Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav accused the Bharatiya Janata Party of winning seats through deceit.
